title: Gartner: about one in five service leaders cut support staff because of AI, and many may rehire
summary: A Gartner survey of customer service and support leaders found that 21 percent have reduced the number of human support agents because of AI. Most have not. Gartner also predicts that half of the companies that cut service staff because of AI will hire people back by 2027, as customers still expect a person for complex or sensitive issues and AI tools fall short of full replacement.
why: Use AI to take routine questions off your team's plate, but keep a clear path to a real person before you cut support staff.
